params.prompt: A hairline line drawing in one single red ink on pure white paper, in the manner of an architect's first site sketch made before anything is built: one confident continuous pen weight throughout, open linework, no shading, no hatching, no grey tones, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos. Beneath the lines, one flat pale wash of warm sand colour laid loosely under the path and the building only, like a single marker stroke that does not stay inside the lines; nothing else is coloured. A few short dimension ticks along one edge of the path and one small registration cross in a corner, as on a plan. Generous white space. Portrait format. Redraw the attached photograph as this kind of line drawing, keeping its exact composition, horizon line, camera height and the positions of the path, the cyclist, the building, the grasses and the survey stakes, so that the drawing would register over the photograph. Subject: a sunlit community room seen from behind three people at a long wooden table: an older woman with her hair in a bun at the centre with a laptop open, a young man on the left in a light tee shirt leaning in to help her, a teenage boy on the right in a hoodie at his own laptop, simple wooden chairs with a cardigan over one, a potted plant on the table, tall windows on the left with leaves outside, a bookshelf and a second table with two more people further back; keep the people as simple confident outlines without faces, and the laptop screens as plain blank rectangles.
